tagline: Bring Asana project updates into Teams and create tasks from chat
metaTitle: Microsoft Teams + Asana Integration: Asana Updates in Teams
metaDescription: Keep Asana projects visible in Microsoft Teams. GAIA posts milestone updates to channels and turns Teams messages into Asana tasks. See the setup steps.
intro:
Project managers track work in Asana while the team communicates in Microsoft Teams, creating a gap where task updates and chat decisions live in separate places. Important action items decided in chat never make it into the project, and deadline changes go unnoticed by teammates in the channel.

GAIA closes this gap by posting project milestones and task updates to Teams channels and by letting team members create Asana tasks directly from messages. Work gets captured where decisions are made and tracked where projects are managed.

useCases.title: Post Asana milestone updates to Teams
useCases.description: When a project milestone is completed, GAIA posts a celebration update to the project channel. The whole team sees progress without needing to open the project.

useCases.title: Create Asana tasks from Teams messages
useCases.description: React to any message with a designated emoji or use a slash command to have GAIA create a task from it. Action items are captured automatically without leaving the conversation.

useCases.title: Deadline approaching alerts
useCases.description: GAIA monitors tasks approaching their due date and posts a warning to the channel. Assignees are tagged so nothing slips past a deadline unnoticed.

useCases.title: Daily standup digest
useCases.description: Before standup each morning, GAIA posts a digest of each team member's tasks due today to the standup channel. The team arrives at standup already up to speed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Microsoft Teams and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your tenant and workspace. GAIA links your projects to their corresponding channels.

howItWorks.step: Configure update triggers and task creation rules
howItWorks.description: Choose which project events post to channels and how message commands map to projects. GAIA gives you per-project control.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates task and project communication
howItWorks.description: Project events appear in the channel as formatted cards with direct links, and tasks started from chat are created with full context. Both tools stay current automatically.

faqs.question: Can any Teams member create Asana tasks, or only admins?
faqs.answer: Any team member whose account is connected to GAIA can create tasks from messages. You can restrict this to specific roles if needed.

faqs.question: Which events can trigger channel messages?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports task completion, milestone achieved, due date approaching, task assigned, and project status changed as trigger events. You choose which ones to enable.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support portfolios and goals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can post portfolio-level status updates and goal progress to channels so leadership gets high-level visibility without drilling into the project.
